notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Patch 1:
- Auto-draw option added for accessibility
- CRT effect toggle added
- Fullscreen toggle added
- Adjusted colors in the skill tree to give clarity on what upgrades are purchasable
- Upgrade descriptions now show up faster when hovering over them
- KB, MB, GB, and TB upgrades now clarify in their description that they auto-convert for purchases when needed
- All bytes move slightly slower
- Moved high visibility line option from settings to skill tree menu
- KB, MB, GB, and TB sizes reduced slightly
- Thickened default draw line slightly
